items.title: Nepal begins overhaul of school curriculum, with AI and indigenous knowledge in focus
items.desc: Nationwide consultations seek to reshape Nepal’s school curriculum by integrating AI, disaster preparedness, entrepreneurship and indigenous knowledge.

items.title: India approves additional 654 MW power exports to Nepal
items.desc: The additional supply is expected to help Nepal manage winter power shortages after floods damaged hydropower plants and transmission infrastructure.

items.title: Finance Minister Wagle to visit India on September 17-18
items.desc: The two-day visit will be the first high-level visit from Nepal to India since the August 26 floods devastated parts of the country.

items.title: Sher Bahadur Deuba faction fractures as 31 leaders join Thapa-led Congress
items.desc: The move follows the party’s decision to accommodate former office-bearers and members as it seeks to avert parallel conventions ahead of the September 19 election process.

items.title: Himalayas approaching tipping point, millions of livelihoods at stake: Report
items.desc: Faster glacier melt is threatening water security and increasing the risk of glacial lake floods across the Hindu Kush-Himalaya, putting millions of people downstream at risk.

items.title: US approves $1m forensic support for Nepal flood victim identification
items.desc: The new funding takes US humanitarian, health and forensic assistance following the floods to more than $5 million.

items.title: Beijing to ban drone possession, storage from November 15
items.desc: The new rules are part of a broader push to tighten airspace security, with limited exemptions for emergency, research, industrial and other authorised operations.

items.title: Nepal Airlines jet grounded in Japan, disrupting international flights
items.desc: The airline’s only operational widebody remains in Narita after an engine problem affected a flight carrying 226 passengers, with Doha services also at risk.

items.title: Flood blocks Jajarkot-Dolpa road, sweeps away homes and shops
items.desc: Torrential rain triggered flooding in Jajarkot’s Nalgad area, disrupting transport on the Bheri Corridor and destroying homes, businesses and other structures.

items.title: Nepal tunnel survivor finds solace in village homecoming
items.desc: Rescued after nine days trapped in a hydropower tunnel, Sanjay Sah returned to his family in a village still mourning workers missing after last month’s disaster.

items.title: Sweden’s centre-left bloc leads close election against right-wing government
items.desc: A narrow early lead for Magdalena Andersson’s centre-left bloc could end Ulf Kristersson’s four-year government and put Sweden’s hardening migration policies under review.

items.title: Booker-winning translator Deepa Bhasthi on why she has ‘nothing kind to say about AI’
items.desc: Bhasthi discusses preserving the soul, musicality and rhythm of a language, and why a translation should not erase its cultural roots.

items.title: A year later, the Gen Z movement lives on in art
items.desc: Songs, theatre, photography and visual art continue to document, mourn and make sense of a movement that transformed Nepal’s political landscape.

items.title: Beijing signals support for rebuilding flood-ravaged Rasuwagadhi route
items.desc: Nepal has sought Chinese assistance to rebuild the 16-km Syaphrubesi-Rasuwagadhi road, while the government prepares a temporary track to restore access to the border crossing.

items.title: Infrastructure Minister Sunil Lamsal on rebuilding after the Bhotekoshi floods
items.desc: The infrastructure development minister discusses plans for resettlement, damaged roads and bridges, the China border crossing and efforts to build safer settlements for disaster-prone communities.

items.title: Nepal fell in love with EVs. It forgot to regulate them
items.desc: Countries certify a battery before it’s sold. Nepal certifies almost nothing. That gap needs fixing.

items.title: Why Nepal’s climate crisis is also a public-health emergency
items.desc: The Bhotekoshi flood shows why Nepal’s climate crisis must also be understood as a public-health crisis.

items.title: What should Balendra Shah tell the world in New York?
items.desc: Ahead of the prime minister’s first UN General Assembly address, experts, leaders and activists share how Nepal should pitch its climate crisis to the world.

items.title: Lawmakers want a shorter governor term. Experts fear instability in central bank
items.desc: Changes in legal provisions could undermine Nepal Rastra Bank’s independence and policy continuity, former governors warn.

items.title: Nepalis cut back on food as ‘hyperinflation’ and shortages bite
items.desc: Consumers in Kathmandu Valley are cutting back on food and festive preparations as supply disruptions and rising transport costs push up the prices of daily essentials.

items.title: Vehicles cross Krishnabhir on Sunday in trial run after 11 days
items.desc: Around 20 vehicles, including a stranded gas tanker and heavy trucks, were allowed through the temporary track, but regular traffic will take several more days to resume.

items.title: At least 129 missing after Indonesian passenger ship capsizes
items.desc: Crews managed to rescue 108 people from ​the stricken Virgo Transport 8 ship and were still searching for any other survivors, the rescue agency added.

items.title: Why can’t consumers exchange other brands’ LPG cylinders amid the shortage
items.desc: A government directive allowing consumers to exchange cylinders across brands has failed to take effect, with gas companies citing legal, technical and insurance complications.

items.title: 18-km cross-border transmission line under MCC completed
items.desc: The Nepal-side section linking the 400 kV New Butwal Substation to the Nepal–India border has been completed, with the line now awaiting approvals and other steps before it can be energised.

items.title: The search dog helping find bodies buried by Nepal’s floods
items.desc: Samba, a Labrador trained to detect the scent of human remains, has helped rescuers locate around 20 bodies beneath mud and debris since the floods hit Rasuwa.

items.title: Rescuers searching for 140 people from Indonesia passenger ship, official says
items.desc: Rough seas complicate rescue as authorities search for passengers still unaccounted for.

items.title: India sends three Bailey bridges to restore flood-hit connectivity
items.desc: The first consignment of components for a 70-metre bridge has reached Hetauda, with the structures to be deployed in flood-hit Nuwakot.

items.title: Two killed, four seriously injured in Rukum West jeep crash
items.desc: The jeep was travelling from Kotgaun towards Khalanga when it crashed in Deuta Khola in Sanibheri Rural Municipality-6.
